title: How Storage Bills Reach the Member and What Arrears Cost, by Storage Programme
content:
Storage account charges under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements are recovered in one of two ways, statements reach the member by one of three channels, and the grace period and the late charge differ by programme. All four columns are posted here.

## Posted terms

| Programme | Storage settled out of grain proceeds | Grace period (calendar days) | Late charge (USD) | Statements reach the member by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | yes | 15 | 25.00 | counter printout |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | yes | 15 | 25.00 | mailed statement |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | yes | 10 | 40.00 | mailed statement |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | yes | 10 | 40.00 | email statement |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | yes | 10 | 40.00 | portal and email |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | no | 10 | 60.00 | portal and email |

## What each column records

**Settled out of grain proceeds.** Five of the six programmes recover storage out of the proceeds of grain sold to the cooperative; the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage does not, and its charges are looked to the member directly.

**Grace period.** The calendar days a storage charge may stand before the late charge attaches: 15 days on the two lowest programmes and 10 days on the other four.

**Late charge.** The money added once the grace period has run: 25.00 on the two lowest programmes, 40.00 on the three in the middle, and 60.00 on the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage.

**Statement channel.** Storage statements reach the member as a counter printout on the Open Storage Account, as a mailed statement on the Grain Bank Deposit Account and the Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage, as an email statement on the Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement, and through the portal and by email on the two highest programmes.

## Notes

**Do the grace period and the statement channel move together?** They do not. The Grain Bank Deposit Account carries the longer grace period of 15 days and reaches the member by post, while the Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement carries 10 days and reaches them by email. Each column is set on its own.

**Is a heavier late charge always matched by a shorter grace period?** Not in every row. The Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage and the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage share a grace period of 10 days while their late charges stand at 40.00 and 60.00 respectively.
